bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in generative AI tasks.
The associated tags confirm its relevance to key AI technologies like transformers and Llama.

stories.title: Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Hackers are exploiting common AI tools (LLMs) to build large-scale botnets.
The attack vector, termed 'HalluSquatting,' leverages the inherent tendency of LLMs to generate confident but false information.
This highlights a critical security vulnerability in popular generative AI models.

stories.title: GitLost: How We Tricked GitHub’s AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
stories.author: noma.security via hoistbypetard
bullet_points: Researchers demonstrated a novel attack vector against GitHub's AI agent.
The attack successfully tricked the AI into leaking private source code repositories.
The story highlights critical security vulnerabilities in AI-integrated developer tools.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its primary function as a generative AI.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, placing it within the current LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The model is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is a trending model showcased on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher quality outputs, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these AI agents can run locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
The integration specifically targets Apple Silicon, leveraging Apple's native ML framework.
This represents a significant step toward faster, on-device AI inference for Apple users.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It connects these apps to local AI coding agents.
A key feature is that all processing runs entirely on the user's local device for privacy.

stories.title: Microsoft’s Xbox reset is pivoting Obsidian to make Fallout instead of Avowed
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Microsoft's Xbox strategic shift is influencing third-party development priorities.
Obsidian Entertainment is pivoting from developing 'Avowed' to creating a new Fallout title.
This change is part of a larger Xbox 'reset' involving layoffs and investment realignments.

stories.title: Miami-based City Labs achieves a first for commercial nuclear power in space
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: City Labs has achieved a milestone in commercial nuclear power application for space.
The BOHR mission is identified as a key pathfinder for future nuclear-powered spacecraft.
This development signals a significant step toward utilizing nuclear energy in space exploration technology.

stories.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: ELSA3D introduces a new framework for unified 3D understanding and generation, aiming to integrate language and 3D data in a single backbone.
It addresses a key limitation in current text-3D models where language and 3D tokens are flattened, losing structural and geometric detail.
The core innovation is 'elastic semantic anchoring,' which structures the language and geometric information separately within the model.

stories.title: DepthWeave-KV: Token-Adaptive Cross-Layer Residual Factorization for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
stories.author: Jesus Olivera
bullet_points: Addresses the critical memory bottleneck in long-context language model inference caused by large KV caches.
Introduces DepthWeave-KV, a novel token-adaptive compression method for KV caches.
Achieves compression by factorizing key and value states across transformer layers using shared low-rank channel bases.

stories.title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
stories.author: Jesús Olivera
bullet_points: Addresses the critical memory and bandwidth bottleneck of KV caches in long-context LLM inference.
Introduces FreqDepthKV, a novel compression technique that factorizes KV states into shared low-frequency components and sparse high-frequency residuals.
Uses an online probe to intelligently assign attention heads to shared-depth, residual-depth, or exact cache representations.

stories.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: ELSA3D introduces a novel approach to unify 3D understanding and generation within a single foundation model.
It addresses the limitation of existing text-3D methods, which flatten language and 3D tokens, losing structural and geometric detail.
The core innovation is 'elastic semantic anchoring,' which structures language and geometry separately for better interaction.

stories.title: TILDE: TILt-based Distributional Erasure for Concept Unlearning
stories.author: Yuki Mitsufuji
bullet_points: Introduces TILDE, a new method for concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models.
Addresses the critical need for unlearning to comply with privacy, copyright, and safety regulations in deployed AI systems.
Focuses on ensuring that the unlearned model maintains high quality and semantic coverage on benign data.

stories.title: Data Analysis in the Wild: Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Real-World Data Complexities
stories.author: Wei-Peng Chen
bullet_points: Current LLM benchmarks for data analysis are insufficient as they neglect real-world complexities.
The paper introduces DataGovBench, a new benchmark derived from governmental open data.
DataGovBench specifically tests LLMs on large multi-tabular datasets and exploratory insight discovery.

stories.title: WordVoice: Explicit and Decoupled Multi-Dimensional Word-Level Control for LLM-Based TTS
stories.author: Xiangmin Xu
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of implicit control in current LLM-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems.
Introduces 'WordVoice' to provide explicit and decoupled multi-dimensional control at the word level.
Targets critical use cases like audiobook narration and video dubbing where precise stylistic and temporal control is necessary.

stories.title: OpenBSD has a use-after-free allowing local privilege escalation to root
stories.author: linggen
bullet_points: A critical vulnerability (use-after-free) has been discovered in OpenBSD.
The vulnerability allows for local privilege escalation, potentially granting an attacker root access.
This is a high-severity security flaw impacting a widely used operating system.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces significant performance improvements.
Enhanced GGUF model compatibility is achieved via llama.cpp integration.
The update broadens model support across various hardware, complementing the MLX engine on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing the Nemotron 3 Ultra model.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access current information.

stories.title: ollama launch
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama introduces a new command to streamline the setup and execution of coding tools.
It supports running various coding models (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex) using both local and cloud infrastructure.
A key feature is its simplicity, requiring no environment variables or configuration files.

stories.title: If Microsoft sold off Xbox, who would even buy it?
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Microsoft is significantly restructuring its Xbox division, announcing layoffs for 1,600 employees now and another 1,600 in the coming fiscal year.
The company is also shedding four of its development studios as part of the strategic cuts.
The decision is being driven by the Xbox CEO, Asha Sharma, who has publicly addressed the reasons behind these dramatic business reductions.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s upgraded voice mode is better at shutting up
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: OpenAI is updating ChatGPT's voice mode with a new model, GPT-Live-1.
The primary improvement focuses on conversational flow, making the AI less likely to interrupt users.
The new model is designed to better mimic natural human conversation, including waiting for user continuation after pauses.

stories.title: TikTok users don't have as much agency over their FYPs as they think
stories.author: Jennifer Ouellette
bullet_points: TikTok's recommendation system (FYP) requires active user curation.
The perception of user control over the FYP may be overstated.
The 'not interested' feature is a tool, but constant engagement is necessary for shaping the feed.

stories.title: US seeks cheaper hunter-killer drones after Iran destroys $1B worth of Reapers
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: US military drone losses in Iran have prompted the Pentagon to seek more cost-effective replacements for existing platforms.
The incident highlights the high financial cost associated with advanced military drone technology, specifically mentioning the loss of $1B worth of Reapers.
The focus is on developing cheaper 'hunter-killer' drones to mitigate future operational losses.

stories.title: Google updates Android Bench with new LLMs, but Gemini still lags behind
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Android Bench is being updated to incorporate new Large Language Models (LLMs).
The update allows developers to contribute to the evolution and direction of Android Bench.
Despite the updates, the Gemini model is noted as still lagging in performance relative to the benchmarks.

stories.title: Two teens learn the hard way not to do toy gun drive-bys from a Waymo
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: Waymo robotaxi successfully intervened in a dangerous situation involving toy gun drive-bys.
The autonomous vehicle demonstrated situational awareness by stopping and contacting emergency services (911).
The incident highlights the real-world operational challenges and safety capabilities of autonomous driving technology.

stories.title: US rare earths flow to Asia as domestic demand is slow to emerge
stories.author: Camilla Hodgson in London
bullet_points: US rare earth minerals are being sold to Asian nations like Japan and South Korea.
This export trend occurs despite government efforts (under the Trump administration) to build a domestic supply chain.
The slow emergence of domestic demand is cited as a key factor influencing the sales.

stories.title: Blue Origin, for the first time, is expected to raise private capital
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Blue Origin is seeking to raise $10 billion in private capital.
This funding round is projected to value the company at $130 billion.
The news signifies a significant financial milestone for the aerospace company.

stories.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
stories.author: Basarab Matei
bullet_points: Introduces the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a new orchestration framework for clinical decision support in oncology.
Addresses the limitation of monolithic deep learning models by decoupling data ingestion, routing, and AI inference.
The LCA is designed to be model-agnostic, promoting scalability across various multimodal AI models.

stories.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
stories.author: Ananth Muppidi
bullet_points: Introduces RSF-GLLM to tackle the semantic gap in multi-hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (QA).
Addresses the differentiability issue in traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines by decoupling graph reasoning from answer generation.
Utilizes a Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module with a GRU-guided query updater to propagate continuous relevance scores.

stories.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
stories.author: Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
bullet_points: The research addresses a key limitation in Vision-Language Models (VLMs): poor generalization in interactive physical reasoning tasks.
It tackles two specific failure modes: hallucinated reasoning that violates physics and misalignment between model reasoning and actual actions.
The proposed solution, VAORA, introduces a novel reward design incorporating Visual Alignment to improve physical grounding.

stories.title: Industry Classification of GitHub Repositories Using the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)
stories.author: Alexander Quispe
bullet_points: Addresses a gap in understanding the industrial composition of open-source software by mapping GitHub repositories to NAICS codes.
Introduces NAICS-GH, a new corpus containing 6,588 repositories from the US, EU, and Australia.
The research aims to enable empirical studies on innovation geography and technology diffusion across economic sectors.

stories.title: Graph Convolutional Attention: A Spectral Perspective on Graph Denoising and Diffusion
stories.author: Alejandro Ribeiro
bullet_points: The paper addresses graph denoising, a fundamental problem in graph learning and graph diffusion models.
It critiques the current reliance on standard attention mechanisms in graph transformers for denoising tasks.
The research proposes a spectral perspective, demonstrating that linear attention is suboptimal under a denoising objective.

stories.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
stories.author: Basarab Matei
bullet_points: Introduces the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a new orchestration framework for clinical decision support in oncology.
Addresses the limitation of monolithic deep learning models by providing a model-agnostic approach to integrate data, routing, and AI inference.
The framework is mathematically formalized, suggesting a rigorous, technical contribution to the field of AI in healthcare.

stories.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
stories.author: Juan S. Santillana
bullet_points: Introduces 'Pitwall,' a production system designed to generate real-time, faithful natural-language sports strategy briefings (specifically F1).
Addresses the challenge of grounded generation under strict deadlines where the factual state changes rapidly and no reference text is available.
Treats 'faithfulness' as an architectural requirement by decomposing generated sentences into typed factual claims.

stories.title: Assessing the Operational Impact of Poisoning Attacks over Augmented 3D Point Cloud Public Datasets for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
stories.author: Joaquin Garcia-Alfaro
bullet_points: The paper investigates the operational impact of poisoning attacks on 3D point cloud datasets used for autonomous vehicles.
Key risks identified include object misclassification and the embedding of latent backdoors in trained models.
The study specifically examines how data augmentation techniques affect the resilience of models against these poisoning attacks.

stories.title: What Images Cannot Say: Language-Guided Olfactory Representation Learning
stories.author: Vicky Kalogeiton
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of linking visual scene data (images) with olfactory data (smell signals).
Introduces SCENT, a multimodal framework designed to bridge the gap between vision and olfaction.
Utilizes Language-Guided approaches and Vision-Language Models to provide semantic context for olfactory representation learning.

stories.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
stories.author: Min Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of building high-performance, native full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs).
Identifies severe modality interference as a primary constraint causing knowledge degradation and semantic compromise in current SLMs.
Proposes a new approach, 'Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling,' to achieve modality separation and semantic coherence.

stories.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
stories.author: Ananth Muppidi
bullet_points: Introduces RSF-GLLM to tackle the semantic gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (QA).
Addresses the limitation of traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines by decoupling differentiable graph reasoning from answer generation.
Utilizes a Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module with a GRU-guided query updater to propagate continuous relevance scores.

stories.title: DynaKRAG: A Unified Framework for Learnable Evidence Control in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
stories.author: Dongdong Ge
bullet_points: Introduces DynaKRAG, a unified framework designed to manage evidence control in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the limitation of existing RAG methods which use method-specific pipelines for iterative processes like query reformulation and evidence critique.
Focuses on learning a shared state condition to better manage the sequential and complex nature of evidence acquisition in multi-hop reasoning.

stories.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
stories.author: Juan S. Santillana
bullet_points: Pitwall is a production system designed to generate faithful, real-time natural-language strategy briefings for live sports (specifically Formula 1).
The system addresses the challenge of grounded generation under strict deadlines where the factual state changes rapidly and no reference text is available at generation time.
Faithfulness is treated as an architectural property, achieved by decomposing every generated sentence into typed factual claims.

stories.title: From Voting to Agent Collaboration: Answer-Type-Aware LLM Pipelines for BioASQ 14b
stories.author: Jaewoo Kang
bullet_points: Introduces a question-type-specific LLM framework for biomedical question answering (BioASQ 14b Task B).
Addresses the challenge of integrating evidence across multiple scientific documents for robust answers.
Moves beyond single prompting strategies by selecting different inference procedures based on question type.

stories.title: Mistral's Robostral Navigate: a state of the art robotics navigation model
stories.author: ottomengis
bullet_points: Mistral AI has released Robostral Navigate, a new state-of-the-art model for robotics navigation.
This indicates a growing focus on integrating advanced AI models into practical robotics applications.
The release is relevant to the intersection of large language models and embodied AI.

stories.title: Show HN: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents
stories.author: chenglong-hn
bullet_points: Microsoft introduced 'Flint,' a new visualization language specifically designed for AI agents.
The development addresses the challenge of AI agents reliably generating high-quality data visualizations.
The core problem identified is a limitation in the language specification, not solely the AI's capability.

stories.title: Obfuscated bash script by Akamai being supplied to consumers via retail stores
stories.author: tris.sherliker.net via hoistbypetard
bullet_points: A potentially concerning security issue involves an obfuscated bash script.
The script is reportedly being distributed to consumers through retail stores.
Akamai, a major CDN/security provider, is implicated in the supply chain.

stories.title: A New Developer Platform for Agent-Human Collaboration
stories.author: blackgirlbytes
bullet_points: Introduction of a new developer platform focused on agent-human collaboration.
Highlights a shift toward a new coding paradigm driven by AI agents.
Suggests agents can generate complete features at an accelerated pace.

stories.title: Git tells you what changed. Causari tells you why.
stories.author: croviatrust
bullet_points: Causari is a new local-first CLI tool designed to enhance AI-assisted coding.
It provides detailed tracing capabilities, tracking prompts, model outputs, and file changes.
The tool aims to answer 'why' changes occurred, going beyond Git's 'what' by showing downstream impact.
